Excellent Indian food in Vietnam! 🇮🇳🇻🇳
Sep 2026 • Friends
Excellent Indian food in Vietnam! 🇮🇳🇻🇳

Had a wonderful dining experience here. The food was authentic, fresh, and full of flavour. The vegetarian dishes were especially delicious and tasted very close to what you would expect from a good Indian restaurant back home.

The spices were perfectly balanced, portions were generous, and everything was served hot and fresh. The staff were also very friendly, welcoming, and attentive.

For Indians visiting Vietnam, this is definitely a great place to enjoy authentic Indian cuisine. Even if you are not Indian, I would highly recommend trying the food here.

Great food + great service + warm hospitality. Highly recommended! 🇮🇳❤️🇻🇳
